summary: Registers a controller shifter/gear action pair into the global action tables and, when the first action ID is a gear action, searches the action table for the paired action to seed a force-feedback state value. Clears the old mapping via IDPairMatchAndClear, writes the two-ID pair at a stride-28 slot indexed by this[125], then dispatches on the second ID through a switch to find the counterpart gear, force-feedback index group and flag; a linear scan over the action table writes literal 1056964608 when a matching entry is found.

operations.description: Call IDPairMatchAndClear(this + 128) to clear the previous ID pair mapping for this binding slot.
Compute the action-table slot offset as 28 * this[125] (field 0x1F4).
Write the first ID (*v2, this[128] at 0x200) into dword_7D1B08 + offset and the second ID (v2[1], this[129] at 0x204) into dword_7D1B0C + offset.
Guard on *v2 (field 0x200) == 1; only gear/shifter actions proceed to pairing and force-feedback setup.

Switch on this[129] (field 0x204) via jump table jpt_46AA0C with lookup data byte_46ACDC, pairing each action value with a counterpart (v5), a feedback-index group (v6) and a flag (result 0 or 1); the default case returns result early.

Scan dword_7D1B0C entries stepping 7 dwords until reaching dword_7D1FDC; when the entry's type (previous dword) is 1 and its value equals v5, write literal 1056964608 into dword_7D1490[216 * result + 27 * v6].
Return result (the flag 0 or 1, or the default-case value).

clean_pseudocode: case 1: case 2: ... : /* map to counterpart, group, flag */
unresolved: Meaning of the stride-28 slot layout and the exact action-ID enum semantics are not established from this function alone.
The force-feedback value written is literal 1056964608; its float interpretation is not derived here.
Whether dword_7D1B08/dword_7D1B0C and dword_7D1490 are per-bind arrays indexed by this[125] depends on caller conventions.
